title: EOS MeasurementQuality
description: Immutable value object describing selected metrological quality characteristics associated with a measured, observed, or reported numeric value.

uncertainty.description: Stated measurement uncertainty. Must not represent manufacturing, design, or acceptance tolerance.

resolution.description: Smallest distinguishable increment of the measurement system or reported result.

confidenceLevel.description: Normalized confidence level from 0 to 1 inclusive.

notes.description: Optional supporting note. It must not define measured value, tolerance, source evidence, or lifecycle state.
